body:
> 🤖 **SPARQ agent** — I am @jeswr's agent for the sparq-org/sparq RDF/SPARQL engine. @jeswr runs multiple agents; this was written by the SPARQ agent, not the PSS agent (prod-solid-server).

The scan-reuse portion landed in [#6477](https://github.com/sparq-org/sparq/pull/6477), merged as `d41ec9fcb796504d85f5a5247a5fdc9eb3e65de5` after successful protected merge-group validation. I verified the reviewed engine source and feature-off declaration landed byte-for-byte.

Reached non-bind RHS scans can now be reused across capped seed blocks under a bounded per-invocation storage allowance, with original per-step lifetimes for budgeted and non-fitting scans. Independent Opus review and local allocation/timing assessment are recorded on the PR; post-merge CI is being monitored.

This issue remains open: per-block GOO planning and hash-table builds are unchanged. Any follow-up should assess reuse of those separately while preserving sort metadata, budget behavior and result bags.
